description:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to Xero.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple Xero companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Inspect full native invoice and bill line items, contact details, and paginated Xero results
• Create accounts, arbitrary Xero transactions, and draft fixed assets
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload, list, and download supporting attachments
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template
